notes.title: Balance Changes (Ver 1.17121801)
notes.notes:
Details of the balance adjustments included in today's update are included below. 

Shared Changes
Strengthened Offensive Unit ability (adjusted no. of shots and shot speed)
Increased amount Armor Drain ability heals.
Increased Explosion ability's affect time and decreased its reload time.
Increased Super Charge ability's affect time.
Using a BOSS beam attack now drains BOSS Mode armor gauge (just as in Duo).
Lev
When in BOSS Mode, opponent will now turn to face Lev's BOSS.
Reduced close-range damage (charge gauge).
Henri
Minor adjustments to hit and completion timing of Bullet Canceller, and AOE of wind pressure
Ursure
Increased durability of BOSS parts
Increased hitstun for M attack (napalm)
Chang Po
Reduced close-range damage (charge gauge).
Cuilan
Increased damage (armor gauge) of normal shots for M attack.
Increased damage (armor gauge) for both S attack and barrage "Roll Bomb"
Reduced damage (especially to charge gauge) of barrage "Orbital Laser"
Hongo
Increased charging time for M attack
Added recovery time post Bullet Canceller
Reduced damage of S attack.
Fabian
Adjusted rotation speed of S attack (slight increase)
Increased durability of barrage attack "Blitz Arrow"
Shinobu
Increased durability of S attack (mine)
Increased damage of main shot (wave)
Increased damage of main shot (standard shot)
Adjusted launch timing (sped up) of barrage "Formation Attack" and increased durability of units.
Increased damage (charge gauge) of alpha cartridge barrage "Sagittarius 2"
Increased damage (armor gauge) of standard shots launched after barrage "Sagittarius 2" lands.
Adjusted BOSS Mode's formation change attack (behaviour and increased damage)
Theo
Removed ability to dash-cancel into bullet canceller (during mode change).
Increased BOSS Mode M attack damage (armor)
Luca
Adjusted homing ability at close range for barrage attack "Hayate" (Alpha > Beta)
Increased damage (charge & armor gauge) of barrage "Hayate" and "Tsumuji"
Ranatus
Increased damage (armor gauge) of M attack (dash)
Increased damage (armor gauge) of barrage "Trio Sonata"
Increased damage (armor) of missiles fired during M attack and Trio Sonata.
Changed beam attack (B) to fire for a fixed length of time (removed ability to extend this by holding down the button)
Added recovery time after firing beam attack (B) 
Mika
Increased durability of S attack (homing missile) and also damage (charge & armor gauge) caused by post impact explosion.
Increased durability of purge unit.
Ernula
Changed beam attack (B) to fire for a fixed length of time (removed ability to extend this by holding down the button) and reduced movement speed during use.
Sakurako
Increased durability of S attack (mine).
Added ability to move and dash-cancel during barrage "Scorpio".
Increased napalm explosion size during dash for barrage "Scorpio".
Increased damage (armor gauge) of standard shots launched after barrage "Sagittarius" lands.
Increased rotation speed for barrage "Fear Volley".
Karel
Increased laser damage (armor gauge) for barrage "Retsu".
Increased damage (armor gauge) of napalm explosion after missile lands in barrage "Sen" and "Ougi".
Lili
Changed S attack so homing lasers are launched once a unit has been destroyed.
Valken
Reduced napalm damage (charge & armor gauge).
Temjin
Adjusted reach of close-range attack.
Reduced movement and dash speed.
Reduced damage (armor gauge) of M attack.
Decreased S attack damage (armor gauge) and increased damage (charge gauge).
Added recovery time after firing BOSS beam.
Stopped rotation when firing BOSS Mode hyper beam (F Laser).

notes.title: 12/20 Update: Lobby, balance, keyboard and more (Ver 1.17121801)
notes.notes:
Today's update includes the following:

Updates

Lobby functionality added
Accessed via Player or Ranked matches: start to look for an opponent, then use X button to open a lobby and choose an opponent. The icon next to the player name shows their connection speed.
Ability select added for Valken and Virtual On DLC
This works the same as with other characters, but will not change the operator.
Extensive balance changes
[strike]Details in a separate post coming later.[/strike]
Details here!
Added ability to change keyboard controls
This is offered via an .ini file found in the installation directory. Open it with a text editor, change the controls to suit you then save the file before running the game. NB: we are unable to support this function, so please use as is.
Minor bug fixes


Abilities select screen (Valken):
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28839815/06280baf2262593031cfef41c3403c77719fd724.jpg

Lobby:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28839815/99daccff4c2fa3b5a7757785c28b023ba78f74c2.jpg

As always, if you have any problems, please feel free to report them here.

Thanks for playing Senko no Ronde 2!

notes.title: 10/03 Update: Balancing improvements and network fixes
notes.notes:
Thanks to all your reports we've been able to address several balancing issues, including one which was affecting network play. Details, as always are below.

Updates

Fixed an issue with some PCs where sound effects were not playing
Fixed an issue which may have switched host and guest in an online match
Fixed an issue where the key guide was not displaying correctly on the character select screen when using a Direct Input controller 
Fixed an issue where using B.O.S.S. Mode in close quarters would  momentarily disable the other player
Fix for Karel's B.O.S.S.Mode spawning without arms if activated after having its arms destroyed
Added a short period of invulnerability when firing a Hyper Beam
Napalm attacks no longer cause knockbacks and can now be guarded using barrier.
Fixed DLC characters leaderboards (Lili & Karel)


If you find any other issues, please report them here.
In particular, if you have any online issues which can be replicated, we're looking into fixes now so any additional information is appreciated.

Thanks for playing Senko no Ronde 2!

Updates

If you find any other issues, please report them here.

notes.title: 9/8 Update: A fix to the online controller pairing bug
notes.notes:
Bug description:  
If you played online and you are NOT the host of the match, your controller button mapping was paired to your Player 2 controls.  This would result in the player being forced to play using the default button mapping even if you had re-mapped your Player 1 controls.  The workaround was to have a second controller plugged in and to re-map those controls.

This bug has been fixed and both hosting player and non-hosting player's controls will reflect the controls that have been mapped to one's Player 1 configuration.

If you find any other issues, please report them here.
